name: doir
description: DOIR language support through the compiler's language server, `doir --lsp`

doir.serverPath.description: The doir executable the extension runs as `doir --lsp`.

doir.format.minify.description: Format Document writes the file on one line: comments, indentation and blank lines go, and a newline that ends a statement becomes `;`. Range and on-type formatting ignore it.

enumDescriptions: Replace a `;` that ends a statement with a line break.
As `newlines`, and break the line after a `{` that has a statement after it on its line.
doir.format.semicolons.description: What formatting does with a `;` that ends a statement.

doir.format.definitionColons.description: Whether a definition's `:` has a space before it.

doir.format.parameterColons.description: Whether a function parameter's `:` has a space before it.

enumDescriptions: Put the `{` on the line of the `=` that opens its block.
Put the `{` on a line of its own below the `=`.
doir.format.braces.description: Where formatting puts the `{` of a block that spans lines. A block on one line, such as `{}`, stays as it is.
